meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 容器每次启动时 mnemon setup 会注册 Claude Code hooks:回复前自动召回相关记忆,每轮对话后存入新洞察。记忆写在按 agent 组的 .claude/ 挂载里,容器重启后仍保留。
howto.when: 只在使用默认 Claude provider 的 agent 组生效,即 container.json 里 provider 缺失或为 claude;换成其他 provider 的组会另起进程、不运行这些 hooks。

say.text: 给这个 agent 组装上 mnemon 持久记忆
查一下记忆有没有写进 /home/node/.claude/mnemon/
say.note: 确认 MNEMON_DATA_DIR 落在挂载路径上

say.text: 清空这个 agent 的全部记忆
say.note: 需停容器并删除宿主机上该组的 mnemon/ 目录

howto.what_en: On each container start, mnemon setup registers Claude Code hooks that recall relevant memory before each reply and store new insights after every turn. Memory lives in the per-agent-group .claude/ mount and survives restarts.
howto.when_en: Applies only to agent groups on the default Claude provider (provider absent or "claude" in container.json). Groups with another provider spawn their own process, so these hooks don't run.

say_en.text: Install mnemon persistent memory on this agent group
say_en.note: Edits Dockerfile and entrypoint, then restarts

say_en.text: Check whether memory is written to /home/node/.claude/mnemon/
say_en.note: Confirms MNEMON_DATA_DIR is a mounted path

say_en.text: Reset all memory for this agent
say_en.note: Deletes that host path's mnemon/ subdirectory
